text_blocks.snippet: Cancer tumors, also known as neoplasms or malignant tumors, are abnormal masses of tissue formed by the uncontrolled growth and division of cells. These cells can invade surrounding tissues and spread to other parts of the body, a process called metastasis. Cancer tumors can be benign (non-cancerous) or malignant (cancerous).
